name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes—like excavation edges—better than generic upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in processing time, but the 0.5%+ capability gain justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem isn’t resolution—it’s the model’s baked-in distortion of facial features during initial generation. RealVisXL’s face upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s flaw either; it’s a bandage on motion artifacts, not the root cause. The real test: run EXCAVA’s worst-case face frames through RealVisXL’s upscaler—if faces stay distorted, the fix fails; if they sharpen without new artifacts, it’s worth the slowdown.
